concept: A boy wants to go outside and play soccer. He runs to the door excitedly with his ball. His mother stops him and says, 'But it’s raining outside.' The boy looks out the window and sighs. He decides to wait until the rain stops.

In a classroom, the teacher asks a question. Most students stay quiet, but one girl raises her hand confidently. She smiles and says, 'I know the answer.' The teacher nods and encourages her to speak. The other students look at her with interest.

At a New Year’s party, people are counting down together. Balloons and decorations fill the room. Everyone shouts, 'Happy New Year!' when the clock strikes midnight. Friends hug each other and make promises for the year ahead.

A group of people are sitting at a café. One person points to a man at the counter and says, 'That guy is my friend.' The guy notices and waves with a big smile. The group waves back, happy to see him.
A boy is very tired after running. He sits on the ground and says, 'I am so tired.' His friend brings him water and pats his back. The boy drinks slowly and feels a little better.
Two children are holding different toys. One child shows his toy car proudly. The other child smiles and says, 'I want the other toy.' They look at each other and laugh before swapping toys happily.

A little kitten is hiding under the table. It peeks out with big, curious eyes. A girl kneels down and gently picks up the little kitten. She strokes its soft fur, and the kitten purrs happily in her arms.

The market is full of people walking between colorful stalls. A man sells fresh vegetables, while another offers baskets of fruit. Children point excitedly at candies on display. The air is filled with voices, laughter, and the smell of food.

An old man is sitting on a wooden bench in the park. He wears glasses and holds a walking stick. Birds gather near his feet as he throws them breadcrumbs. Children run past him, and he smiles gently, enjoying the moment.
A boy is looking for his lost toy car. He bends down and peeks under the bed. The car is covered in dust but still shiny. He grabs it with a big grin and shouts, 'I found it!'
